description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If Clever Conjurer has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Fatestitcher or Clever Conjurer
